description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402] name -> address, or address -> primary name (give exactly one). A name resolves to its TARGET address, which can differ from its owner; a registered name with no target resolves to nothing (NOT_FOUND) and its owner is never substituted. An address's primary name is returned only if that name resolves forward to the same address, so a spoofed reverse record is never trusted.
